scope: Five complete trial-lambda functional execution counts, logical target access/row observations; no gem5, physical hardware or uninstrumented application performance outcome.

subject_source_identity.summary: per-trial exclusive counts, median whole-call estimate
subject_source_identity.packaging_evidence: Source/candidate/profile states are retained; count binding is independent execution evidence.

binding.note: Registered source excerpts, input generator and original timed kernel lambda verified; each trial and SourcePicker selection retained.

counting.vector_multiplicity: instrumented before vectorization and unrolling; existing fixed vectors counted by lane
counting.operation_definition: Normalized IR arithmetic/comparison operations; FMA counts two floating-point operations; checked integer arithmetic counts the result and overflow predicate (two per lane); branches count terminator executions; optimizer hints, address and cast instructions excluded.
counting.loop_definition: Body entries when the header condition chooses inside/outside; header entries for other loop shapes.

coverage.count_coverage: normalized instructions in selected debug functions; indirect callees and other translation units are not claimed
missing_counts: callee bodies outside selected debug functions and other translation units

observation_contract.first_access_scope: first observed access in selected normalized source functions; opaque initialization is not observed
